question: What's the latest Ollama release and what changed?

message.content:
As of my knowledge cutoff date in June 2024, I cannot provide information on Ollama releases beyond that point, including any updates released in October 2026.

Ollama is a rapidly evolving project, and new versions are frequently released with improvements to model support, performance, new features, and bug fixes. To get the most up-to-date information on the latest Ollama release and its changes, I recommend checking the official Ollama website (https://ollama.com) or their GitHub repository (https://github.com/ollama/ollama), where release notes and changelogs are typically published.

For the latest details, visit:
- Ollama Releases: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases
- Ollama Docs: https://docs.ollama.com

These resources will provide the most accurate and current information about the newest release and what has changed.
